description: Report where an engagement stands — derived from the engagement file's real events, not a stored status. With an engagement id, it shows which steps are on the chain, what's next, and any open items (the close can't be signed while any remain). With no id, it lists the client's engagements and the firm's own status. If the file's hash chain fails re-verification it refuses to report rather than vouch for a tampered record.

engagement_id.description: The engagement to report on. Omit to list all engagements + the firm status.

name: engagement_status
